purpose: Official due-diligence source expansion. Source verification does not imply a site-specific pass until a coordinate or title join is executed.

sources.coverage: registered land and property in England and Wales; property summaries, title registers and title plans
sources.binding_limit: Title plans show general boundaries rather than exact legal boundaries. Downloaded online copies are not proof of ownership; official copies are required when evidential proof is needed.

sources.coverage: Flood Zones and planning-oriented flood information for England
sources.binding_limit: The map is a planning-screening source and does not guarantee whether an individual property will flood. Site-specific flood risk assessment may still be required.

sources.coverage: nationally protected historic buildings and sites in England
primary_join_keys: British National Grid point or polygon
sources.binding_limit: A heritage designation is a planning constraint, not evidence of ownership, market availability or exact cadastral identity.

sources.publisher: Natural England and MAGIC partner organisations
sources.coverage: authoritative natural-environment and designated-site datasets across Great Britain
sources.binding_limit: MAGIC supports screening for protected sites and environmental constraints but is not survey-level evidence and does not establish title boundaries.
